description: oriiion STAFF ONLY. Give a colleague access to a customer's account. An email with no oriiion account becomes a member-only login: no onboarding, no subscription of its own, and every sign-in opens the customer's account. An existing user gets the account in their switcher. Sends nothing unless sendLoginEmail is true.

accountEmail.description: Login email of the customer account the person should reach (the company's account).

email.description: The colleague's email. Becomes a member-only login if it has no oriiion account yet.

sendLoginEmail.description: Email the colleague a one-time sign-in link (valid 7 days). Only when the human asked for it.

name: add_account_member
title: Add a Colleague to a Customer Account
